messages.subject: Welcome to the new debian-r list!
messages.subject_clean: Welcome to the new debian-r list!
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

The new debian-r mailing list is now created, and if you read this message, it
means you have been subscribed (normally all people listed at r-pkg-team as of
2018-02-28 are subscribed, see [1]).

Let me recall the purpose of this list:

 Maintenance of R packages in Debian
 Discussions about the packaging in Debian of R packages, in particular from CRAN or Bioconductor. 

Cheers,

[1] https://salsa.debian.org/groups/r-pkg-team/-/group_members

-- 
⢀⣴⠾⠻⢶⣦⠀  Sébastien Villemot
⣾⠁⢠⠒⠀⣿⡁  Debian Developer
